clock_policy.denial_text: The current user does not have permission to change clocks for GPU 00000000:C1:00.0
clock_policy.conditioning: constants are published per clock state over clock-stationary batches; constants are never averaged across clock states

definitions.warm_state: steady state of consecutive back-to-back launches of the identical kernel with identical arguments on identical buffers in one stream, no host synchronization between launches, after discarding the first 20 repetitions
definitions.rotated_state: identical except buffers cycle over a pool whose distinct footprint exceeds the 40 MiB L2 by at least a factor 8
definitions.clock_stationary_batch: NVML SM clock equal immediately before and after the batch, memory clock exactly 1593 MHz on both sides, NVML throttle reason word zero on both sides
definitions.clock_conditioned_constant: mean of batch means over the clock-stationary batches of one cell in one clock state, requiring at least 8 such batches
definitions.R_hbm: maximum achieved bytes per second over every lane-1 cell at 256 MiB and above in the boosted arm

gemm_families.role: granite output projection and expert gate/up

scored_expectations.claim: At S = 2048 MiB the read rate is in [1700, 1937] GB/s.
At S = 2048 MiB the write rate is in [1700, 1937] GB/s.
At S = 2048 MiB the copy rate is in [1600, 1937] GB/s.
At S = 2048 MiB the triad rate is in [1600, 1937] GB/s.
The four rates at 1024 MiB and the four at 2048 MiB agree pairwise within 3 percent.
R_hbm lies in [1700, 1937] GB/s, that is 83.4 to 95.0 percent of nameplate.
For every lane-1 cell measured in both arms, the ratio of the 1275 MHz constant to the 1410 MHz constant is in [0.98, 1.02].
For every family, at M = 1 the measured time is within [0.9, 2.5] times t_mem.
For every family, the measured time is nondecreasing in M up to a tolerance of one timer quantum plus 2 percent, over the whole grid.
For every family, the roofline efficiency is monotone nondecreasing in M over the grid from M = 1 to M = 4 M*, to a tolerance of 0.02.
For every family, the measured knee lies in [0.7 M*_meas, 4 M*_meas].
For every family, at M = 4 M* rounded to the grid, the achieved rate is at least 45 percent of P(clock).
At M = N = K = 8192 the achieved rate is at least 85 percent of P(clock) in the boosted arm.
For every family the efficiency at M = 1 is below 0.62 and the efficiency at the largest grid M is above 0.62.

Every held-out shape is predicted by log-linear interpolation of the neighbouring grid entries within 12 percent absolute percentage error for M outside [0.5 M*, 2 M*] and within 25 percent inside it.
Across every held-out shape of every family, the median absolute percentage error of the interpolated surface is below 10 percent and the p95 is below 20 percent.

For the lane-2 cells measured in both arms, the ratio of the 1275 MHz constant to the 1410 MHz constant is in [1.06, 1.13] whenever the cell's measured roofline regime is compute, and in [0.98, 1.02] whenever it is memory.
The roofline efficiency of a cell is the same in both arms to within 0.03 absolute, for every cell measured in both.
For both geometries the prefill time ratio between S = 4096 and S = 2048 is in [3.2, 4.4].
At S = 4096 the synthetic geometry reaches at least 40 percent of P(clock) on the combined score and value flops.
For every decode cell with KV bytes at least 160 MiB, the achieved KV bandwidth is in [0.55, 1.00] times R_hbm.
Decode time is linear in L at fixed B for B at least 16: the ratio between consecutive L values is in [3.4, 4.6].
Decode time is linear in B at fixed L = 8192 for B at least 16: the ratio between B = 256 and B = 64 is in [3.4, 4.6].
Every cell of the frozen expert-load grid is memory-limited under the frozen work model at the measured R_hbm, that is t_mem is greater than t_flop.
Over the expert-load grid at fixed shape, the measured time varies by at most a factor 1.6 between M_e = 1 and M_e = 54.
At M_e = 54 the achieved rate is below 25 percent of P(clock) for both shapes.
The measured time at M_e = 14 is within [1.0, 3.0] times t_mem for both shapes.
At 256 MiB every lane-5 kernel achieves at least 80 percent of R_hbm on its own compulsory byte count.
At 64 MiB every lane-5 kernel achieves at least 80 percent of R_hbm.
For every lane-5 cell, the warm and rotated constants agree within 6 percent at 64 MiB and above.
At 4 MiB the warm scale constant is not more than 1.15 times faster than its own compulsory-bytes-over-R_hbm time.

fatal_guards.claim: The job sees exactly one NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB, MIG disabled, ECC enabled, and no foreign compute process occupies it at the start or the end.
Every scored constant is computed only from clock-stationary batches of a single clock state, and every scored cell has at least 8 such batches in the state it is reported for.
The memory clock reads exactly 1593 MHz and the NVML throttle reason word reads zero on both sides of every scored batch.
No measured rate exceeds its nameplate ceiling: 2,039.04 GB/s for any lane-1 cell, and P(clock) for any GEMM cell at that batch's clock state.
No measured kernel time falls below its own compulsory-traffic floor max(t_flop, (distinct_bytes - L2_bytes) / R_hbm).
Every lane-3 decode cell and every lane-4 expert cell satisfies t_mem greater than t_flop under the frozen work model.

Every reported cell used exactly the frozen warmup discard K, the frozen batch count and a batch size satisfying the frozen 200 microsecond rule, and every timed batch is bracketed by CUDA events on the measured stream.
Every GEMM cell returns a numerically correct result on a fixed element sample, checked once per cell outside the timed region.
Every scored cell's per-repetition coefficient of variation, over the clock-stationary part of its 64-repetition diagnostic chain, is at most 0.02 plus q divided by sqrt(12) times the median.
Every scored cell's batch-mean coefficient of variation within its reported clock state is at most 0.02.
The batch-mean constant and the per-repetition mean of the same cell agree within 3 percent.
Both lane-1 arms and both lane-2 arms observe the same GPU UUID, and the study records the UUID, driver, toolkit, source digest and binary digest of the exact executed harness.
